lesson: Unit 4 – Lesson 11: Get ready for A1 Movers & Fun corner
outcomes: Read definitions and write the correct job words.
Listen to the whole dialogue before you choose.
Use job words, must and mustn't in a board game.

tf.s: 'This person is cooking some food' is a chef.
'This car is taking a person to the hospital' is a police car.
'This person is repairing a car' is a mechanic.
'This person is working in a field' is a dentist.
tf.why: A farmer works in a field.

tf.s: In Listening Part 4, you must listen to the whole dialogue.
tf.why: Well done! The answer can change later.

tf.why: Yes! Read all the sentences carefully.

tf.why: The answer may change later, so listen to the end.

tf.why: Arriving on time is good, so you go forward.
